occurrences.text: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
